Definition: to tinkle, i.e. rattle together (as the ears in reddening with shame, or the teeth in chattering with fear)
BiblicalUsage: tsâlal is the ordinary word for to tinkle, i.e. rattle together. It appears 4 times in Scripture, including 1 Samuel 3:11 and 2 Kings 21:12.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that tsâlal is one of the small details that matter in Scripture.
